facts.fact: The Ministry of Lands' e-Ardhi system, covering planning, surveying, allocation, registration and valuation, is already in use in Dodoma, Arusha, Tanga, Mbeya and Mwanza regions and several municipal and district councils, per TanzaniaInvest.
A Ruvuma assistant commissioner for lands said citizens can sign their title deed through e-Ardhi while in any region, without travelling to the region where the service originated.
